put.description:
Partial update — only fields present in the body are changed. Reassigns which
existing group/subgroup/mat_name/spec/brand/unit row this material points to
(by id); it does not rename shared master rows, and mat_code is never accepted
from the client. If any of group_id/subgroup_id/mat_name_id/spec_id/brand_id/
unit_id changes, mat_code is auto-regenerated server-side as
group_code+subgroup_code+mat_name_code+spec_code+brand_code+unit_code (the
confirmed composition rule), and the change is cascaded in the same
transaction to every table that references mat_code — including stock_item,
which has no FK and would otherwise silently lose its link to this material.
If the regenerated code would collide with a different existing material, the
update is rejected with 409.

get.description: Returns COMPLETED PRs that still have at least one line with remaining (qty_requested - qty_ordered) > 0. Uses qty_requested rather than qty_to_order because qty_to_order is a one-time snapshot computed at PR-submit time against stock_item.qty and is never resynced afterward — stock consumed elsewhere post-submit (or missing at submit time) left stale qty_to_order values that could hide PRs which still genuinely need purchasing. A PR can appear here even if it already has an active PO — split ordering lets the same PR line be divided across multiple POs/suppliers as long as some quantity is left; see GET /po/pr-lines/{pr_id} for the per-line remaining breakdown.

put.description:
Cancels the PO and all of its lines (status='CANCELLED' on both), which frees
up the source PR lines' qty_remaining for re-ordering — PRHandler.LinesWithPOStatus
computes qty_ordered/qty_remaining live from purchase_order_line rows, filtering
out ones with status='CANCELLED'. status_receive is left untouched: if goods were
already received, that's a physical fact recorded in stock_inventory and is not
erased by cancelling the PO — a cancelled PO can legitimately still show
status_receive='PARTIALLY_RECEIVED'/'RECEIVED' as a historical record. Reversing
physically-received stock is a separate stock-adjustment/return flow, not part of this endpoint.

Allows editing a PO with status=APPROVED or PENDING_REAPPROVAL, provided the PO's created_at is less than 1 year old. Requires a mandatory non-empty reason, logged to po_edit_log. Replaces header fields and all lines, recomputes totals server-side, sets status to PENDING_REAPPROVAL, and reopens the PO's existing approval_request row (same approval_id / assigned_to — not a fresh approver lookup). Idempotent while already PENDING_REAPPROVAL: repeated saves before the approver acts just keep re-editing and re-pending the same approval_request, so the frontend can call this endpoint for every save in this flow, not just the first.
put.summary: Edit an already-approved PO (requires reason, triggers re-approval)

post.description: Inserts purchase_order_line rows. For lines that reference a pr_line_id, increments purchase_request_line.qty_ordered and re-evaluates the parent PR status to PARTIALLY_FILLED or FULFILLED. Runs in one transaction with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the touched PR lines to prevent concurrent double-booking.

put.description:
Only allowed when status='COMPLETED'. Blocks with 400 if any PO derived from this
PR's lines (via purchase_order_line.pr_line_id) is not yet "closed" — closed means
status='CANCELLED' OR status_receive='RECEIVED' (a fully-received PO has already
served its purpose and no longer needs to block PR edits). The system does not
auto-cancel/auto-close anything; the user must get the referencing PO(s) to one of
those states manually first. Reverses any stock
deducted by deductStockOnSubmit (stock_transaction rows with ref_doc_type='PR',
ref_doc_id=id, txn_type='OUT') by restoring stock_item.qty and recording an
offsetting 'IN' transaction, then sets status back to DRAFT. Relies on the
confirmed rule that a PR never has duplicate mat_code across its own lines, so
reversing by ref_doc_id=pr_id alone (without a pr_line_id column on
stock_transaction) is unambiguous.

One DB transaction. Locks each line's source stock_item row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE),
verifies sufficient qty, moves stock according to transfer_type (WH_TO_WH: deduct

post.description: Parses the same Excel file as /stock/items/import but does not write anything. Each row's mat_code is checked against material_code, joined out to mat_group/subgroup/mat_name/spec_size/brand/unit (LEFT JOIN — any link can be null). The file's DESCRIPTION text is compared (whitespace-normalized, case-insensitive) against "mat_name + spec_description" from the master. Per row: code_found, master (object with mat_code/group_name/subgroup_name/mat_name/spec_description/brand_name/unit_name, or null if code_found is false), name_matched, and a derived status ("ok"|"code_not_found"|"name_mismatch"). Response also includes a summary count of ok/code_not_found/name_mismatch.

put.description:
Accepts the same body shape as Create (models.CreateWorkOrderRequest) — lines are
always replaced together with the header in this single call, mirroring
POHandler.Update's all-in-one PUT rather than requiring a separate lines call.
The dedicated PUT /work-order/{id}/lines endpoint remains available for a
lines-only edit that doesn't touch header fields. Only allowed while
status = DRAFT — mirrors PO's Update rule exactly (PO also rejects everything
else, including REJECTED, and points APPROVED callers at its edit-approved
endpoint instead; WO has no such endpoint yet, so APPROVED/other statuses just 400).
The payload's own `status` field ("บันทึกร่าง" sends DRAFT, "ส่งอนุมัติ" sends
PENDING_APPROVAL) is written to the row and, when it actually changes, logged to
work_order_status_log — a transition to PENDING_APPROVAL also opens the step-1
approval_request exactly like POST /:id/submit does, since this is an alternate
entry point into the same submit flow. Any other status value is rejected —
approval decisions only ever happen through the dedicated Approve/Reject flow.

post.description:
Opens the step-1 approval_request if doc_type='WO' step 1 is configured in
approval_config; otherwise the status change happens with no approval request
(mirrors MemoHandler.Submit's hasConfig guard). Actual approve/reject happens via
PUT /approval/WO/{id}/approve|reject (GenericApprovalHandler), not here.

status.description:
Status is only read by Update (PUT /work-order/:id) — Create always hardcodes 'DRAFT'
in its INSERT. Update accepts "DRAFT" (no-op save) or "PENDING_APPROVAL" (the "ส่งอนุมัติ"
button submitting inline) — anything else, including jumping straight to APPROVED, is
rejected; approval decisions only ever happen through the dedicated Approve/Reject flow.
